# stalwart_jmap (Data Source)

Configures JMAP protocol limits for requests, uploads, and push notifications. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `changes_max_results` (Number) Determines the maximum number of change objects that a Changes method can return
- `event_source_throttle` (Number) Specifies the minimum time between two event source notifications
- `get_max_results` (Number) Determines the maximum number of objects that can be fetched in a single method call
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `max_concurrent_requests` (Number) Restricts the number of concurrent requests a user can make to the JMAP server
- `max_concurrent_uploads` (Number) Restricts the number of concurrent file uploads a user can perform
- `max_method_calls` (Number) Limits the maximum number of method calls that can be included in a single request
- `max_push_size` (Number) Maximum size in bytes for a Web Push notification payload; EmailPush objects are truncated to fit within this limit
- `max_request_size` (Number) Defines the maximum size of a single request, in bytes, that the server will accept
- `max_subscriptions` (Number) The default maximum number of push subscriptions a user can create
- `max_upload_count` (Number) Specifies the maximum number of files that a user can upload within a certain period
- `max_upload_size` (Number) Defines the maximum file size for file uploads to the server
- `parse_limit_contact` (Number) Limits the maximum number of vCard items that can be parsed in a single request
- `parse_limit_email` (Number) Limits the maximum number of e-mail message that can be parsed in a single request
- `parse_limit_event` (Number) Limits the maximum number of iCalendar items that can be parsed in a single request
- `push_attempt_wait` (Number) Time to wait between push attempts
- `push_max_attempts` (Number) Maximum number of push attempts before a notification is discarded
- `push_request_timeout` (Number) Time before a connection with a push service URL times out
- `push_retry_wait` (Number) Time to wait between retry attempts
- `push_shards_total` (Number) Total number of shards for push notification processing across multiple nodes
- `push_throttle` (Number) Time to wait before sending a new request to the push service
- `push_verify_timeout` (Number) Time to wait for the push service to verify a subscription
- `query_max_results` (Number) Sets the maximum number of results that a Query method can return
- `set_max_objects` (Number) Establishes the maximum number of objects that can be modified in a single method call
- `snippet_max_results` (Number) Maximum number of search snippets to return in a single request
- `upload_quota` (Number) Defines the total size of files that a user can upload within a certain period
- `upload_ttl` (Number) Specifies the Time-To-Live (TTL) for each uploaded file, after which the file is deleted from temporary storage
- `web_push_contact` (String) Optional contact URI (a mailto: or https: address) included as the sub claim of VAPID tokens so that push services can reach the server operator. Leave empty to omit the claim.
- `web_push_key` (Attributes) ECDSA P-256 private key (PKCS#8 PEM) used to sign VAPID (RFC 8292) authentication tokens for Web Push. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--web_push_key))
- `websocket_heartbeat` (Number) Time to wait before sending a new heartbeat to the WebSocket client
- `websocket_throttle` (Number) Amount of time to wait before sending a batch of notifications to a WS client
- `websocket_timeout` (Number) Time before an inactive WebSocket connection times out

<a id="nestedatt--web_push_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `web_push_key`

Read-Only:

- `file_path` (String) File path to read the secret from
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Password or secret value
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.
- `variable_name` (String) Environment variable name to read the secret from
